name: Debbie Dingell
stance: Urges Congress to act now on AI guardrails prioritizing safety, accountability and human oversight rather than building first and regulating later.

statements.text: Congress must act now to place guardrails on AI that prioritize safety, accountability, and human oversight.
We should not build first and regulate later. Innovation matters, but protecting our lives, our freedoms, our humanity, and our future must come first.
